review_note: The Windows Soloist visualizer adds WASAPI process capture. The lock adds only wasapi 0.27.0, which uses Windows audio and COM APIs. Existing block-buffer and RSA versions and the vendored handshake and playback trees are unchanged.

assessments.impact_statement: The maintainer advisory explicitly affects >=0.11.0,<0.12.1. Version 0.10.4 predates the inline cursor implementation. OSV currently overmatches the older version. Version 0.12.0 was upgraded to 0.12.1.

The selected Windows graph reaches rsa only through librespot-core. Its sole production use imports RsaPublicKey, BigUint and Pkcs1v15Sign, then verifies the server handshake signature with a public modulus/exponent. Lime does not create an RSA private key or call RSA private-key decryption/signing. The Marvin private-key timing leak therefore has no secret private key or vulnerable private operation in this application path. This assessment is limited to the pinned feature graph and reviewed source hashes; it is not an upstream patch.
